links.comparator_used: Running the model on all patients without OOD filtering (performance on flagged OOD patients compared with performance on in-distribution patients in a simulated training-deployment scenario)
links.outcome: Ability of OOD detectors to identify patients on whom the classification model performs worse, across image, transcriptomics and time series datasets
links.effect: Several OOD detectors consistently identified patients on whom the model performs worse; no numeric effect sizes reported in the abstract. Several detectors also flagged patient subsets underrepresented in the training data.
links.quote: Using a simulated training-deployment scenario, we find that several OOD detectors consistently identify patients on which the model performs worse.

design_hint: out-of-distribution detection to filter unreliable predictions
